name: Long-Term Residence Permit for the Purpose of Investment

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum investment of CZK75,000,000 (up to 60% of which may be tangible or intangible assets, including technologies and know-how).
The investment must create at least 20 new jobs for EU citizens (or their family members) for a minimum period of 2 years.

evidence_required.document: Investment plan and proof of committed capital

outcome.duration_length: up to 2 years, renewable (60-day extension processing)

sources.title: ipc.gov.cz -- Long-Term Residence Permit for the Purpose of Investment: CZK75 million minimum investment, 20-job creation requirement, 2-year duration, Schengen free movement rights

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Czechia's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. This is an active-entrepreneurship investment route (job creation required), distinct from a passive golden-visa-style scheme -- categorised as 'business' rather than 'settled' accordingly, consistent with this dataset's convention of reserving 'settled' for routes that themselves grant a long-term/permanent status. The source does not specify a path to permanent residence or family-member provisions for this specific permit; leads_to_pr set false pending clearer confirmation, though holders can presumably transition to cz_permanent_residence via the general 5-year continuous-residence route like any other long-term residence permit holder. Holders may travel within the Schengen Area without a separate visa.
